description.1341:
Acme Links is a link shortener with built-in analytics, built for marketers, founders, and small teams.

Create a short link in seconds, share it anywhere, and watch clicks arrive in real time. Every click is recorded with timestamp, geography, device, and referrer, so you can see which channels actually perform. Destinations are editable after the link is shared: re-point a campaign link without changing the URL you already distributed.

Typical uses: tracking newsletter and social campaigns, QR codes on print material, and lightweight attribution for launches. A REST API covers programmatic link creation and analytics export.

Free tier available. Paid plans add custom domains, more links, and higher click volumes.
description.2192:
Acme Links is a link shortener with built-in analytics.

The core idea: turn long URLs into short, memorable links and see exactly what happens after you share them. Every click is recorded with timestamp, geography, device, and referrer, and the analytics dashboard updates in real time.

How it works: you paste a destination URL, get a short link back, and share it anywhere. Links remain editable after sharing — you can change the destination at any time without breaking the short URL people already have.

What it is for:
- Tracking newsletter, social, and ad campaigns
- QR codes on packaging, posters, and print material
- Lightweight launch attribution without a full analytics platform
- Teams that want link management via API

What it deliberately is not: an enterprise marketing suite. There is no tag manager, no pixel installer, and no per-seat pricing. Acme Links sits at the link layer, which means it works with any stack and any analytics setup you already use.

Technical notes: redirects resolve at the edge for low-latency responses worldwide. A REST API covers link creation, destination updates, and analytics export.

Acme Links is free while it is early — no credit card required. Paid plans add custom domains, higher link and click volumes, and team features.

assets.notes: Paths are relative to the working directory where you run the CLI. The referenced files must exist before running `submit` — sites that ask for a logo or screenshot upload will fail without them. Create ./assets/ and add a square 512x512 PNG logo plus at least one product screenshot.

elevator_answers.problem: Long URLs are unshareable and give you no idea what happens after you share them.
elevator_answers.audience: Marketers, founders, and small teams running campaigns across many channels who want click data without installing a full analytics platform.
elevator_answers.differentiator: It works at the link layer: editable destinations and real-time analytics with nothing to install on your site, plus an API for programmatic link management.
